Read JIRA User Story details and then update `user-story.md` and `requirements.md`.

- Extract functional requirements (FR-*), non-functional requirements (NFR-*), and acceptance criteria (AC-*).
- Ask up to 5 clarifying questions only if needed.
- Keep everything testable and specific.
